metadata.services: Triple Play Bundle: Fiber 500 + Digital TV + Voice ($110/mo)

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Jessica. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Jessica. My name is Thomas Taylor. I'm calling because I got an email saying my automatic payment didn't go through this month.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, Mr. Taylor, I can definitely help you with that. To access your account, can I please get the phone number associated with it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I'm pulling up your account now... I see Thomas Taylor. For security purposes, can you please verify the 4-digit security PIN on your account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you for verifying. You're all set. Now, you mentioned a notification about a failed payment?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's right. I'm pretty sure it's because my credit card on file expired. I got a new one in the mail a few weeks ago and forgot to update it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a very common reason, not to worry. Let me check the billing system... Yes, I can confirm that. The automatic payment for your Triple Play Bundle, in the amount of one hundred and ten dollars, was declined on the 15th. The reason code is 'Expired Card'.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's what I thought. So, I need to pay that balance, and then I'd like to set up the new card for autopay going forward.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. We can take care of both of those things on this call. We can start by processing the one-time payment for the past-due balance of one hundred and ten dollars. Do you have the new card with you?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I have it right here. I'm ready.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Could you please provide me with the 16-digit card number?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I have four-two-seven-two, five-eight-zero-one, eight-nine-three-three, six-four-one-nine. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the expiration date?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: August of 2027. Got it. And the three-digit CVV security code from the back of the card?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That is 7-3-4.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay... 7-3-4. Thank you. Please hold on for just a moment while I securely submit this payment for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Mr. Taylor. The payment has been approved. I have a confirmation number for your records, it is 9-8-C-B-5-5-1-2. Your account balance is now zero.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent. Thank you. Now, for the autopay...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, of course. Would you like to use the same card we just used for the payment to be your new card on file for recurring automatic payments?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please. That's the one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. One moment while I update your recurring payment profile. I'm first removing the old, expired card to avoid any future confusion.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sounds good.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, that's done. Now I'm adding the new card ending in 6419 to your autopay profile. So, just to formally confirm, you are authorizing Cymbal Telecom to automatically charge this card for your monthly service fees on your bill's due date?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I authorize that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. I've saved the changes. Your autopay is now active with the new card. You'll continue to receive the five-dollar monthly discount for being enrolled in autopay and paperless billing.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, right, I forgot about that. That's great. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome. So, to recap, we successfully processed a payment for one hundred and ten dollars, bringing your account balance current. We also updated your automatic payment method to your new card, so your next bill should be paid automatically without any issues.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's exactly what I needed. Everything is sorted.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Mr. Taylor? Any questions about your services or account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's it for me. You've been very helpful, Jessica.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure to help. Thank you for being a Cymbal Telecom customer, and have a wonderful rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Bye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
